record.field: from datetime import date, timedelta alert_date = date.today() + timedelta(days=7) orders = env['dg.china.supply'].search([ ('state', 'in', ['in_transit', 'customs']), ('eta_date', '<=', str(alert_date)), ('eta_date', '>=', str(date.today())), ]) for order in orders: order.message_post( body=f"⚠️ ETA Alert: This China supply order is due to arrive within 7 days ({order.eta_date}). Ensure inspection team is ready.", message_type='notification', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', )

from datetime import date, timedelta cutoff = date.today() - timedelta(days=1) pending = env['dg.quality.inspection'].search([ ('overall_result', '=', 'pass'), ('certificate_issued', '=', False), ('inspection_date', '<=', str(cutoff)), ]) if pending: count = len(pending) refs = ', '.join(pending.mapped('name')[:5]) env['mail.message'].create({ 'body': f"📋 {count} quality inspection(s) are PASS but have no Certificate of Conformity issued: {refs}{'...' if count > 5 else ''}", 'message_type': 'notification', 'model': 'dg.quality.inspection', 'subtype_id': env.ref('mail.mt_note').id, })

from datetime import date, timedelta due_soon = date.today() + timedelta(days=30) employees = env['hr.employee'].search([ ('health_surveillance', '<=', str(due_soon)), ('health_surveillance', '>=', str(date.today())), ('active', '=', True), ]) for emp in employees: emp.message_post( body=f"🏥 Health Surveillance Due: {emp.name}'s health surveillance is due on {emp.health_surveillance}. Please schedule appointment.", message_type='notification', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', )

from datetime import date, timedelta due_soon = date.today() + timedelta(days=60) due = env['maintenance.equipment'].search([ ('loler_required', '=', True), ('loler_next_due', '<=', str(due_soon)), ('active', '=', True), ]) for equip in due: equip.message_post( body=f"🏗️ LOLER Alert: {equip.name} LOLER inspection due {equip.loler_next_due}. Book with certified inspector.", message_type='notification', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', )
